assertion.uniformity: Finite dimensions, standard characters, fixed geometry/Lipschitz bounds and positive correlation are uniform in h,N.

assertion.normalizations: The vector is unit, scalar components need not be; vertical identities hold on all representatives and all limit elements.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Frequency zero is permitted. Top-trivial case reduces to ordinary compact test approximation.
assertion.limit_order: Complete finite-family extraction at order s-1, choose finite approximants, choose finite assignments, then take ultralimits.
